title: ProvDelegation
description: Rootless facet — PROV Delegation: "the assignment of authority and responsibility to an agent (by itself or by another agent) to carry out a specific activity as a delegate or representative, while the agent it acts on behalf of retains some responsibility for the outcome of the delegated work." Source: W3C PROV-DM (REC-prov-dm-20130430) §5.3.4 Delegation, actedOnBehalfOf(id; ag2, ag1, a, attrs); PROV-O prov:actedOnBehalfOf.

id.description: Optional identifier for this delegation relation (PROV-DM §5.7.1: two delegations are equal if they have the same identifier).

delegate.description: The agent associated with an activity, acting on behalf of the responsible agent (PROV-DM §5.3.4, ag2, mandatory). Must be identifiable (§5.7.1).

responsible.description: The agent on behalf of which the delegate agent acted (PROV-DM §5.3.4, ag1, mandatory). Must be identifiable (§5.7.1).

activity.description: The activity for which the delegation link holds (PROV-DM §5.3.4, a, optional).

attributes.description: Optional set of attribute-value pairs with additional information about this delegation link (PROV-DM attrs; reserved PROV attributes per §5.7.2 — prov:label, prov:type — plus application-specific attributes, PROV-DM's extensibility point, §6).
